name: Drink Magic
doc: Drink Magic (Ochu's enemy attack; the act family): one emitter per action - its sound, an actor system (its actor data the exe's) and the drunk magic: streaks and five twisted ribbons with their sparks from round the target to the caster, the swelling orb at the caster fading out and back in; the damage. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag037_drink_magic.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its state functions called from the phases, its parts spawned by it): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own - and the exe data words pointing into it (the engine's global index, the word)

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: The act family's master: once its children are gone, the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the ribbon spawner, the streaks, the ribbons and their sparks (the port's)
run by the master, nothing spawned there

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the actor system (its actor data the exe's), the ribbon spawner, the master's release, the damage

parts.title: Ribbons
parts.doc: The drunk magic: five twisted ribbons with their sparks and the streaks, from round the target to the caster

parts.title: Orb
parts.doc: The swelling orb at the caster: fades out, holds, fades back in

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: Spawned by the emitter (its actor data the exe's)

groups.label: Streaks
groups.doc: One a tick of the spawner, flying to the caster

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of its target from this tick

params.label: First tick
params.doc: The first ribbon at this spawner tick

params.label: Every
params.doc: The next ones every this many ticks (the last two together)

params.label: Spread
params.doc: How far from the emitter's midpoint the ribbons and streaks start

params.label: Twist
params.doc: A ribbon's twist a tick (4096: a turn)

params.label: From
params.doc: The first streak at this spawner tick

params.label: Until
params.doc: The last streak at this spawner tick

params.label: Acceleration
params.doc: Added to a streak's speed a tick (4096: the whole line)

params.label: Appear tick
params.doc: Shown at the caster from this tick

params.label: Fade
params.doc: Its fade out and back in a tick (4096: all of it)

params.label: Hold
params.doc: Ticks between its fade out and fade in

params.label: Spin
params.doc: Its twist and swell angles a tick (4096: a turn)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the actor system and the ribbon spawner, the master's release, the damage.
